storage.implementationPhase: 3.4 (offline app shell; data UI still DEMO)

commonFields.id: stable string, scoped by athlete and entity
commonFields.observedAt: ISO-8601 timestamp or date according to granularity
commonFields.retrievedAt: ISO-8601 timestamp; nullable for local records
commonFields.precision: resolution or decimal places; nullable when unknown

stores.name: athletes
stores.purpose: Athlete identity and public profile fields; no tokens

stores.name: activityDetails
stores.purpose: Sport-specific details, laps, exercises, GPS and sensor series in one activity detail aggregate

stores.name: observations
stores.purpose: Health and performance history; distinct observations for each metric and granularity

stores.name: rawRecords
stores.purpose: Original provider payload with provenance, separate from normalized data

stores.name: equipment
stores.purpose: Shoes and equipment; user overrides recorded separately

stores.name: personalRecords
stores.purpose: Supported personal bests linking canonical activities

stores.name: trainingZones
stores.purpose: Source-defined HR and pace zones; effective dates

stores.name: plans
stores.purpose: Plan metadata, goal, dates, availability, publication status and revision

stores.name: sessions
stores.purpose: Prescribed sessions with separate completion links and manual-edit metadata

stores.name: planChanges
stores.purpose: Explicit plan edit history and conflict context

stores.name: preferences
stores.purpose: User-owned preferences, keyed by scope and name

stores.name: syncState
stores.purpose: Incremental cursors, confirmed ranges, pending and failed blocks

rules: DEMO data never enters real stores without an explicit later import policy
No provider secrets, passwords, access tokens or raw authenticated headers in IndexedDB
Missing metric is null with availability metadata, not a fabricated zero
Idempotent upsert uses canonical IDs; preserve original provider provenance
Read views consume normalized records, not raw provider payloads
Derived metrics must identify calculation name and algorithm version
Plan concurrency is revision-based; unresolved conflict must not overwrite silently
No persistence implementation or runtime imports in phase 3.1
